# A loop in a package-level variable initializer runs inside the compiler's
# generated package initializer, where simd operations do not link, so it is not
# rewritten. The same kind of loop in a function is.

loopvec .
cmp stdout stdout.want
cmpenv stderr stderr.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

var spaces = func() string {
	b := make([]byte, 200)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = ' '
	}
	return string(b)
}()

func Xor(x byte, b []byte) {
	for i := range b {
		b[i] ^= x
	}
}
-- stdout.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

var spaces = func() string {
	b := make([]byte, 200)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = ' '
	}
	return string(b)
}()

func Xor(x byte, b []byte) {
	_vcUint8s0 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(x)
	{
		_w1 := b[:len(b):len(b)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint8s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_v1 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c1)
			_v1.Xor(_vcUint8s0).Store(_c1)
			_v2 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c1[_lanes:])
			_v2.Xor(_vcUint8s0).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_v3 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_v3.Xor(_vcUint8s0).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_v4 := simd.LoadUint8s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			_v4.Xor(_vcUint8s0).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_v5 := simd.LoadUint8s(_w1[_i:])
			_v5.Xor(_vcUint8s0).Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint8sPart(_w1[_i:])
			_v6.Xor(_vcUint8s0).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
